mapper.select: SELECT o.id,o.payment_status,o.verification_status,o.cancel_reason,o.refund_order_id, o.current_refund_application_id,o.current_aftersale_id,o.reschedule_count, o.paid_at,o.confirm_deadline,o.confirmed_at,o.canceled_at,o.confirm_mode, o.pay_amount,o.refunded_amount,p.payment_id,p.source_event_id,p.result_type, p.channel_paid_at,p.channel_paid_amount,r.rescheduled_at,r.new_confirm_deadline AS reschedule_deadline, r.new_start AS reschedule_start,r.new_end AS reschedule_end,o.appointment_start_at,o.appointment_end_at FROM pet_order o LEFT JOIN order_payment_result p ON p.order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN order_reschedule_record r ON r.order_id=o.id AND r.reservation_id=o.reservation_id AND r.user_id=o.user_id AND r.store_id=o.store_id WHERE o.order_stage='PENDING_CONFIRM' AND o.id > #{afterOrderId} ORDER BY o.id LIMIT #{limit}
